description.p: SpeedyNote is a fast, open-source note-taking application designed for stylus users who need iPad-quality annotation on budget hardware. Built with native C++ and Qt, it delivers 360Hz stylus input on hardware as modest as an Intel Celeron N4000 at 1.1GHz — with no Electron bloat.

Annotate PDFs with pressure-sensitive inking tools including pen, marker, and highlighter, all rendered as vector strokes that zoom infinitely without pixelation. Organize your work with multi-layer editing, paged notebooks, or infinite edgeless canvases with lazy-loading tiles.

ul.li: Instant PDF loading with clickable internal links and outline navigation
Multi-layer editing with add, delete, reorder, and merge operations
Touch gestures: two-finger pan, pinch-to-zoom, and palm rejection
Cross-platform note sharing via .snbx notebook packages
Powerful command-line interface for batch PDF export and notebook management
Multi-tab editing to work on multiple documents simultaneously
Auto-save so you never lose work
New LinkObject/Highlighter UX with region style selection, color override, and region selection.
New position link object feature to link to a specific position in a document.
Region outside of pages in paged mode now acts as the pan tool when any tool is selected.
Repositioned the LinkObjectBar to be more accessible and intuitive.
Repositioned the search button and the search bar for easier access.
Trackpad axis autolock feature to prevent accidental horizontal scrolling Mac touchpads.
New performance overlay for the viewport to show the frame rate and memory usage. Press F10 to toggle.
Vastly improved long stroke rendering performance.
Adjusted stylesheet of the text box format bar for better visibility and accessibility.
Completely redesigned text box feature with WYSIWYG editing, markdown support, and OCR conversion.
New multi-source PDF relinking/management feature to handle multiple PDFs in a single document.
Vastly improved picture inserting performance.
Made each scroll bar hide and show ondemand.
Combined the export to PDF and .snbx features into a single export dialog.
3 Separate buttons for text box, link object and image object insertion.
Fixed the problem that a starred document in the launcher lost its star after a name change.
Updated the Object insertion UX to be more consistent and intuitive (right click to create and left click to select, with an alternate mapping toggle)
Automatically resize the inserted images to fit within a page / tile on insertion.
Made the page wheel picker support wheel input.
Fixed the problem that the onnxruntime model download script always downloaded the amd64 version of the models on ARM64 systems.
Removed obsolete SDL2 and DocumentConverter code from the codebase.
Fixed the problem that InsertedObjects could be moved outside a page and could never be selected again.
Page wheel picker is now positioned right next to the handle on the scroll bar to be more accessible.
Vastly improved the scrolling performance of the viewport with non-blocking PDF rendering during scrolls.
Made the scroll bars hidden in edgeless mode.
Fixed the problem that the viewport scroll bar handle was not updated when the user clicks on a color marker of a LinkObject.
Multi-PDF support: import pages from multiple PDFs into a single document, navigate between them with outline navigation, and export mixed-source PDFs with combined outlines.
New per-document settings override panel.
New search markers feature for highlighting search results on the viewport.
New per-viewport scroll bar with document map and search/LinkObject markers for better navigation and highlighting of search results.
Fixed the search next behavior so that it scrolls the viewport to the next search result and ensures the keyword is in the viewport.
Added a per-document settings override panel.
Added color and thickness preset cycle keyboard shortcuts.
New auto-switch tool for object-mode and highlighter shortcuts.
Fixed the page eviction/preload thrashing issue when the user edited pages in a document with pictures inserted.
Fixed the problem that images could sometimes fail to be copied to the .snb folder.
Fixed the problem that undo/redo features did not work well with multiple stroke layers.
Fixed the problem that not both pages were OCR'd when the user wrote on both before a scan.
Fixed the problem that the OCR scanning button on the subtoolbar only scanned one page.
Fixed the problem that the font size on the OCR text overlay could be too big to fix in on the overlay.
Disabled grid snapping unless CJK grid snapping is enabled to increase accuracy..
Fixed the problem that all characters of a word could stack together on the OCR text overlay when line snapping was not enabled on the Mac version.
Fixed the problem that erasing didn't trigger an OCR text update.
Handwriting OCR on Linux: recognize handwritten notes locally and on-device using PaddleOCR, with support for Latin scripts, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Added a 2-column option for the page panel on the left sidebar.
Fixed the problem that pages with very high vertical resolution were not rendered.
Increased the precision of the PDF text extraction so that single characters can be selected and copied.
Fixed the problem that the save document dialog was displayed when no changes were made to the document.
Fixed the problem that the Qt standard button translations were not applied.
Fixed the problem that the stroke could be pixelated at high zoom levels.
Fixed the problem that selected pen, marker and eraser presets were not persistently saved.
Fixed the problem that German and Portuguese translation files were not included in the release package.
New French, Spanish, German and Portuguese translations.
Color override option for the lasso tool.
Fixed the problem that closing one panel of the viewport split resulted in the pane being blank instead of merging with the other pane.
Fixed the problem that a lot of file pickers were opened (resulting a crash) when inserting an image with a stylus on ChromeOS Crostini.
Fixed the problem that deleting a markdown note of a LinkObject resulted in a "missing note" placeholder on the right sidebar.
Enabled the cached OCR text boxes on unsupported systems.
Updated the tab bar sizing and auto-hide behavior.
Persistent by-page and by-LinkObject markdown note outline on the right sidebar, enabling viewing and navigating to all markdown notes without loading all the pages or tiles.
Adjustable right sidebar width.
Per-thickness-preset minimum stroke width for the pen tool.
New highlighter styles (Cover, Underline, Dotted underline) for the highlighter tool.
New keyboard shortcuts for the highlighter tool and the OCR features.
Customizable text color of the on-canvas text box.
Fixed the problem that auto OCR feature was not responsive.
Fixed the problem that the scan all button doesn't scan the pages that are not currently loaded.
Fixed the problem that the text box visibility was not updated when the user scrolls the viewport.
Corrected the affinity of the OCR text boxes.
Fixed a positioning issue when a text box is initially created across multiple tiles in edgeless mode.
Fixed the problem that the text editor might not show up properly when the user double clicks on a text box.
New on-canvas text box feature that supports markdown rich text editing. Ctrl+F shortcut to search for text in the text box.
Fixed the problem that the image assets might be deleted randomly in edgeless mode.
Fixed another thumbnail renderer memory leak.
Customizable mouse wheel sensitivity for the viewport scrolling.
New lasso eraser tool for erasing strokes with a lasso selection.
Adjustable left sidebar width.
Fixed the problem that the outline panel showed non-displayable characters.
Fixed a thumbnail renderer memory leak.
New hand tool for panning the viewport around without using the mouse wheel or touchscreen.
Fixed the problem that copying and pasting strokes or inserted objects from the left pane to the right pane did not work.
Adjustable minimum stroke width for the pen tool.
Fixed the problem that the caps of exported marker strokes had incorrect opacity.
Modified the iPadOS version build script to support building on ARM64 Macs.
Fixed the problem that the registry was not cleaned up after uninstalling the app on Windows.
Fixed a keyboard shortcut conflict.
Viewport split support in mainwindow for multi-document editing.
New PDF dark mode rendering option with image region detection bypass.
PDF dark mode rendering and stroke darkening options for PDF export.
Extended drag-and-drop support for .PDF and .snb bundles.
New session restore feature for restoring previous sessions.
New inserted image aspect ratio lock option.
Detailed translation guide for contributing translations.
Fixed the subpixel positioning mismatch between the stroke preview and the actual stroke.
Fixed the subpixel rendering issues on inserted images.
Fixed the problem that the markdown note entries were not copyable or displayed and sized correctly on the sidebar.
Fixed the inconsistencies when relinking a PDF document to one that already has a PDF loaded.
Added a lock option to the page panel action bar.
Integrated the subtoolbars into the tool buttons.
Fixed the problem that a lasso-selected area could not be moved from one page to another.
Changed the undo stack of paged mode to a global stack.
Improved the frame rate of the outline panel.
Fixed the problem that a selected inserted object stayed selected after switching to another tool.
Fixed the high RAM usage in high zoom levels.
Adjusted the default color palette for a nicer appearance and higher contrast.
Fixed the problem that the size of the first page of a notebook did not match the settings.
Fixed the file dialogs so that they preserve the last used directory.
Fixed the problem that switching between the mainwindow and the launcher made the launcher window disappear.
Fixed the problem that the launcher window shifted down every time the user switched between the mainwindow and the launcher.
Fixed the problem that lasso tool didn't clear the originally selected strokes.
Fixed some stylesheet issues.
Updated some icons.
New palm rejection feature.
Fixed the problem that the strokes became stepped or could not be generated at all at very high zoom levels.
Fixed the eraser performance issues at high zoom levels.
Fixed the problem that the edgeless canvases could not show a thumbnail on the launcher.
Fixed the problem that the clipboard action bar was misaligned after folding the left sidebar in some cases.
Replaced the text icons on the object insertion subtoolbar description input popup with actual icons for UI consistency.
New batch delete feature in the launcher
Improved the viewport scrolling performance on low-end devices
Optimized the stroke creation delay on low-end devices
Changed to a new .SVG icon on all platforms
Fixed tab switching causing jump to last page
Fixed PDF internal links broken on some versions
Fixed PDF text search highlight misalignment with inserted pages
Fixed starred view staying empty on first use
Migrated exclusively to MuPDF for all PDF operations, resolving library conflicts with Poppler
Fixed minor UI misalignments

description.p: Major update with PDF text search, batch export to PDF and .snbx, command-line interface, and system notifications.
